full_prompt_en: A square isometric pixel-art illustration shows a small teal-walled workroom floating against a plain deeper teal background. The visible room is an open corner with a tan tiled floor, two blue walls, and a large bright window on the right. At the center, a dark-haired person with black glasses leans over a wide white sheet on a wooden desk, holding a pencil in one hand. The figure wears a muted blue shirt, dark trousers, and black shoes, with the feet visible under the tabletop. A simple brown chair supports the seated posture. Small jars, drawing tools, and a desk lamp cluster along the right end of the table, while a phone-sized colored object and supplies lie near the front edge. At the left wall, several framed pictures of blue skies and landscapes hang in an uneven group above a small cabinet. An open laptop rests on that cabinet, with a few books and objects on shelves below. The wide right window glows cream-white; tiny potted plants and upright books line the sill, and a circular clock hangs between the window and picture group. The room has been cut away at the near corner, so the tiled floor ends in a clean diagonal shape rather than filling the whole square. The view looks down from above, making the desk, chair, wall displays, and window readable at once. Bright daylight from the right window casts a pale blue triangular patch onto the floor outside the room and gives the desk area a soft warm highlight. Blocky pixels, stepped outlines, and limited shaded color clusters define every small object without smoothing them into realism. The overall composition is cozy and orderly, balancing a dense craft-filled center with broad empty teal space around the tiny room.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形等距像素画把一间青蓝墙面的工作室小角落悬浮在更深的青蓝背景中。可见房间是一处开放转角，有棕黄色瓷砖地面、两面蓝墙和右侧一扇明亮大窗。中央，一位黑发、戴黑框眼镜的人伏在木桌上一张宽阔白纸前，一手握铅笔。人物穿柔和蓝色上衣、深色长裤和黑鞋，双脚在桌下可见。一把简单棕色椅子支撑坐姿。小罐、绘画工具和台灯聚在桌子右端，前缘放着手机大小的彩色物件和用品。左墙上几幅蓝天与风景画框高低错落，挂在一只小柜上方。打开的笔记本电脑置于柜顶，下面的隔层放着一些书与物件。宽阔右窗发出奶油白亮光；细小盆栽和直立书籍排列在窗台上，画框组与窗之间挂着圆钟。近处房间转角被剖开，瓷砖地面因此止于清楚的斜边，没有铺满方形画面。视点从上方俯看，使书桌、椅子、墙面陈列和窗户同时可读。来自右窗的明亮日光在房间外的地面投出淡蓝三角形光斑，也为桌面区域添上柔和暖色高光。块状像素、阶梯边缘和有限的明暗色簇定义每件小物，却没有将其抹平为写实。整体构图舒适而有序，以手作用品密集的中央对照小房间四周大片空旷青蓝空间。
style_prompt_en: An isometric pixel-art treatment builds small forms from visible square color clusters and stepped dark outlines. A limited teal and blue palette establishes broad quiet fields, while tan, warm cream, and a few brighter accents draw attention to the compact center. Flat planes meet at clear diagonal angles; narrow shadow blocks beneath overlapping parts make the miniature space readable without smooth gradients. Repeated tiny rectangles and dots supply detail, but the outer area remains mostly empty and uniform. Light enters from one side as a bright pale field, producing a crisp light patch and softer warmer highlights inside. The pixel grid remains apparent even where many small objects gather, lending a handmade game-art texture. The result is intimate, tidy, and gently playful.
style_prompt_zh: 等距像素画表现用可见的方形色簇与阶梯状深色轮廓构建小形体。有限的青绿和蓝色建立宽阔安静色域，棕黄、暖奶油色与少量更亮色点把注意力引向紧凑中央。平面以明确斜角相接；重叠部分下方的狭窄阴影块使微缩空间清楚易读，而不靠平滑渐变。反复出现的小矩形和点状痕迹提供细节，外围区域却大体空旷而均匀。单侧光以明亮浅色区域进入，留下清楚光斑和内部较柔和的暖高光。即使许多小物聚集，像素网格仍然可见，带来手工游戏美术般的肌理。效果亲密、整洁而轻快。
theme_en: A pixel-art illustrator working at a desk beside a bright window
theme_zh: 明亮窗边伏案作画的像素画插画师
name: Pixel drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
